items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Jules Barnes was playing with me then.

ctx.x: Yvonne. That's right. Well he followed us in Beaumont. And they had a fellow that played piano named Patterson. And his wife used to play together. So we played in Beaumont one night and we played in, what was that place in the back there, Orleans? Port Arthur? Galveston? Port Arthur. Port Arthur. Yeah. But then they had a little train called, in the Irvings. He used to play in some of the things that carried back from Beaumont to Port Arthur. Yeah. And I played over there with him. So I met an officer over…
Jules was playing trombone. Trombone. Yeah.
Jules Lee was the, wait, Jules Barnes.
The trombone, and Lee was the drummer.
